description: This PHP source file defines the ConfigurationProvider class within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically handling configuration for the S3 Regional Endpoint. It provides methods to generate configuration providers based on environment variables, configuration files, fallback defaults, and composition of multiple providers, ultimately returning promises that resolve with configuration objects.

classes.name: ConfigurationProvider
classes.description: A PHP class providing methods to generate and manage configuration options for the AWS S3 Regional Endpoint, utilizing environment variables, config files, default fallbacks, and chaining of multiple configuration sources, all encapsulated with promise-based asynchronous handling.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Creates a default configuration provider that checks environment variables, shared config files, and fallback options, with optional caching if a cache interface is provided.

methods.name: env
methods.description: Returns a provider function that retrieves the regional endpoint configuration type from environment variables.

methods.name: ini
methods.description: Returns a provider function that reads the configuration from a specified INI file and profile, defaulting to environment-specified or default paths.

methods.name: fallback
methods.description: Provides a fallback configuration with default endpoint type.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Converts various configuration representations into a ConfigurationInterface object, handling callables, promises, strings, arrays, and objects.
